headline: Exchange Inflows Rose To 671.1 Million Dollars As Binance Took In 207.7 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 671.1 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.2461 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, up from 325.9 million dollars and 0.1196 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the larger print means that arrival sped up. Binance took in 207.7 million dollars and Bitstamp took in 180.1 million, while OKX took in 217.1 million, Bitget shed 72.4 million, and Bitfinex shed 60.0 million.
author: jordan
